checks.name: 40-card premium deck and four-card puzzle draw
checks.detail: 10 values (1–10) × 4 suits = 40 unique cards; every puzzle draws exactly 4 cards; the remaining 36 stay in the deck, so deck + puzzle = 40 at all times.
checks.source: official 24 Game rules; engine.js makeDeck / conservationOk; test.js deck and long-run conservation checks

checks.name: standard poker footprint and premium stock
checks.detail: Card faces are 63×88 mm (300gsm equivalent); the CSS card aspect-ratio is exactly 63/88 so rendered pip geometry keeps the standard playing-card proportion.
checks.source: ART-GUIDE card dimensions; data.js CARD_ASPECT; index.html .card-face aspect-ratio

checks.name: standard pip arrangements for ranks 1–10
checks.detail: A/1 = 1 pip, 2–10 = 2–10 pips; layouts are 2 vertical, 3 vertical, 4 corners, 5 corners+centre, 6 two columns of three, 7 +upper centre, 8 +lower centre, 9 two columns of four+centre, 10 +upper/lower centre. The full deck carries 220 pip marks.
checks.source: ART-GUIDE pip rules; data.js PIPS; test.js PIP_COUNTS and data.js pip-count assertions

checks.name: suit colours follow the standard deck
checks.detail: Spades and clubs are black (#1c1a17); hearts and diamonds are red (#a13a32). Suits are cosmetic only and never enter the arithmetic.
checks.source: standard playing-card colours; engine.js SUITS; index.html .card-face.red/.black

checks.name: walnut table, ivory paper stock and brass token
checks.detail: The premium composition uses the generated walnut table.webp, ivory card-paper.webp and brass-token.webp materials; every card face, pip, corner index and mirror is drawn in code/SVG rather than generated as an AI image.
checks.source: games/assets/art/premium/24game materials; art-render.html; ART-GUIDE code-drawn card faces

checks.name: exact rational solving and guaranteed solvable puzzles
checks.detail: Every published puzzle is generated only after an exact integer-fraction enumerator finds a solution. Difficulty bands use canonical-expression counts: easy ≥4, normal 2–3, hard exactly 1. All four card values must be used exactly once.
checks.source: Bilibili BV1Xz4y1Z7yg (recursive solver), BV1FB4y1U7dF (rules), BV1UrBxYsE2F (variants); engine.js solveValues/generatePuzzle; test.js generated-puzzle checks

checks.name: safe parser rejects non-rules forms
checks.detail: The recursive-descent parser uses no eval/Function, rejects decimals, letters, scientific notation, semicolons and function calls, rejects division by zero, and compares the final fraction to 24/1 exactly. The four card values are checked as a multiset.
checks.source: Bilibili BV1GP1kBDExW (strategy course); engine.js tokenize/parseExpression/checkAnswer; test.js parser and usage tests
